verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee lets developers control timing/completeness tradeoffs via wait-for-selector, JS scenarios, block_ads/block_resources flags, and an 'auto' mode that picks the cheapest successful configuration, giving direct levers over latency vs. completeness. However, this is all documented capability with no independent benchmarking or hands-on confirmation of actual latency impact. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of latency-completeness tradeoffs, explicit 'wait' or timeout parameter documentation, and real-world performance data beyond vendor docs.
